detailed_descriptions.en: DIVE. CATCH. COOK. SERVE. Build and run a sushi restaurant with your friends but don’t expect everyone to stay in the kitchen. Dive into the depths, hunt for fresh seafood, prepare every order, and work together through each chaotic service. MAKE YOUR CHARACTER YOUR OWN Choose your look and stand out from the crew. Customize your outfit, colors, hairstyle, and accessories to create a chef that truly feels like yours. SLICE IT. ROLL IT. SERVE IT. Prepare sushi step by step. Add the ingredients, follow each recipe, and turn your fresh catch into handcrafted exotic sushi. From precise cuts to finished rolls, every plate is made by your own hands. THE DEEP BITES BACK Not every catch comes easy. Dive with your crew, track dangerous sea creatures, and fight sharks, piranhas, squid, electric fish, and octopuses to bring home your next big catch. BRING THE RIGHT TOOL Use specialized tools above and below the surface. Catch fish, explore the ocean, clean up disasters, and choose the right equipment before diving into deeper waters. EXPLORE THE OCEAN The ocean is full of life. Discover colorful fish, strange creatures, and rare sea animals as you explore its deeper layers. Some are easy to catch. Others are better left alone. MORE TABLES. MORE ORDERS. MORE CHAOS Start with a simple sushi restaurant and grow it into a busy seaside restaurant. Add more tables, unlock better stations, expand your menu, and serve even more customers.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
DIVE. CATCH. COOK. SERVE.

Build and run a sushi restaurant with your friends but don’t expect everyone to stay in the kitchen. Dive into the depths, hunt for fresh seafood, prepare every order, and work together through each chaotic service.

MAKE YOUR CHARACTER YOUR OWN

Choose your look and stand out from the crew. Customize your outfit, colors, hairstyle, and accessories to create a chef that truly feels like yours.

SLICE IT. ROLL IT. SERVE IT.

Prepare sushi step by step. Add the ingredients, follow each recipe, and turn your fresh catch into handcrafted exotic sushi. From precise cuts to finished rolls, every plate is made by your own hands.

THE DEEP BITES BACK

Not every catch comes easy. Dive with your crew, track dangerous sea creatures, and fight sharks, piranhas, squid, electric fish, and octopuses to bring home your next big catch.

BRING THE RIGHT TOOL

Use specialized tools above and below the surface. Catch fish, explore the ocean, clean up disasters, and choose the right equipment before diving into deeper waters.

EXPLORE THE OCEAN

The ocean is full of life. Discover colorful fish, strange creatures, and rare sea animals as you explore its deeper layers. Some are easy to catch. Others are better left alone.

MORE TABLES. MORE ORDERS. MORE CHAOS

Start with a simple sushi restaurant and grow it into a busy seaside restaurant. Add more tables, unlock better stations, expand your menu, and serve even more customers.
